Card

The container surfaces, built from the platform’s own global classes and utilities rather than a Material component.

Page container

Wrap a page in .page-container rather than hand-rolling it. It carries a 12px radius, a 1px neutral border, the light surface and 16px of padding — widening to 24px at 1920px and above.

Cards and panels

A card is a composed set of utilities, not a component — 8px radius on the surface, neutral border, and p-4 unless the content genuinely needs room, in which case p-6.

p-4 (default) and p-6template convention

Do not reach for mat-card

Material’s card is not part of the design system. Composing the surface, border and radius from utilities keeps a card themable and avoids inheriting Material’s own elevation and padding scale.

Radius pairing

8px on controls and cards, 12px on dialogs and page-level containers. A card nested inside a page container therefore reads as slightly tighter than its parent, which is intentional.

Where this comes from

Every value on this page was read out of the platform source at build time, so it cannot drift from the app. Regenerate with pnpm design-system:export.
